data.title: 雪之下雪乃 · 暖桌冬夜
data.description: 【雪之下雪乃 · 暖桌冬夜】冬夜窗外细雪纷飞，屋内暖桌散发着让人沉沦的温暖。雪乃整个人缩在毛毯与暖桌间，怀里抱着一只毛绒猫咪玩偶，双颊被烘得泛着红晕——「进入暖桌之后……确实连站起来的意志都会被瓦解呢。今晚就允许你和我一起在这多呆一会儿。」
data.action: 穿针织家居服坐在暖桌毯边，双臂抱猫咪毛绒玩偶，脸颊微微泛暖
data.promptProse: Yukino holds the plush cat in both arms above the kotatsu blanket, looking down with a rare relaxed smile. Preserve her long-sleeved knit top, lounge trousers and warm socks. The medium view includes the quilt folds beside the tabletop and snowfall beyond the apartment window. The existing table lamp illuminates her black hair, blue eyes and the blanket surface facing it; the covered heater supplies warmth without a visible glow through the fabric. A gentle contact shadow surrounds the toy’s soft body. Cool window light separates the farther quilt edge from the darker room, keeping the winter interior calm rather than uniformly bright.
